timing: Frozen before any LP2 target run; exploratory controls only

scorer.provenance_limit: This is a separately pinned model, but overlap of its training data with the 17 known readings has not been independently excluded. Do not describe the score control as held out.

known_page_scope: All 17 decoded page streams in the frozen known-readings file, separately by page; no selection of favorable pages after outcomes.
plant: Add GP index 7 modulo 29 to every rune of each known page. Exact correct local decryption shift is 7 at every complete three-rune block.
search: For each page scan all 3 starting phases and all 29 ranked output rows. Preserve all tied shifts and blanks; no independently chosen fragment substitutions outside the source heatmap. Maximize mean English quadgram log10 likelihood over contiguous printed Latin segments, with blank blocks breaking segments. A candidate is eligible only with >=100 scored quadgrams. Scores use the fixed model above and are descriptive; top-row exact-rune recovery is also measured.
null: 49 shared seeded controls with seed 20261023: within each known page, shuffle its GP indices once per trial, add 7 modulo 29, and repeat the same full 3-phase by 29-row scan; use the maximum over all eligible page/phase/row candidates in each trial.
power_gate: Before considering LP2, the planted known-text max must exceed at least 47 of the 49 whole-search shuffle maxima and the selected output must contain at least 70% of the known plaintext runes in exact positions across complete blocks. Failure means the heatmap/scorer is too weak for a negative LP2 finding under this setup.
limits: The source only prints local fragments, not a unified decoder. The quadgram score is an added diagnostic, not an upstream acceptance rule. A shift-7 plant is simple and cannot validate interrupted or changing alphabets. Do not test LP2 if this gate fails.
